qa_pair.question: For pre-seeded session eval-01, use inspectStyle with target {kind:session,sessionId:eval-01} and input {action:validateCurrentMap}, then read the session context resource. Are the validation result and context counts consistent? Answer True or False.
For pre-seeded session eval-02, use inspectStyle with target {kind:session,sessionId:eval-02} and input {action:listLayers,query:road}. What one layer ID is selected?
For pre-seeded session eval-03, use inspectStyle on session eval-03 with input {action:getLayer,layerId:roads}. What is the roads line-color?
For pre-seeded session eval-04, use inspectStyle on session eval-04 with input {action:listSourceLayers,sourceId:basemap}. Which source-layer name belongs to roads?
Use inspectStyle without target and input {action:analyzeGeoJson,data:<the exact eval-05 points FeatureCollection>}. What is the feature count?
For pre-seeded session eval-06, inspectStyle the points source and complete style resource. What single geometry type is counted?
For pre-seeded session eval-07, use exportStyleSession with {sessionId:eval-07} and read its style resource. What is the current revision number?
For pre-seeded session eval-08, use inspectStyle with input {action:getLayerCount}. What is the layer count?
For pre-seeded session eval-09, inspectStyle with input {action:listLayers,query:places}. What is the source ID?
For pre-seeded session eval-10, use inspectStyle with input {action:validateCurrentMap} and inspectStyle {action:getLayer,layerId:roads}. Are the style facts consistent? Answer True or False.
